b5f4ff7fe134c1530e627c43.answer: For an Indian fintech, I’d compare SISA, BDO India and Coalfire. SISA: payments-focused, ASV and pentest, medium evidence automation, QSA/ROC/AOC, indicative ₹5–15L. BDO India: strong readiness, scanning usually via partners, medium automation, readiness and assessment support, indicative ₹4–12L. Coalfire: strong for complex cloud fintech, ASV and pentest, Compliance Essentials automation, QSA/ROC/AOC, indicative ₹8–20L+. Pricing is indicative and depends on CDE scope and validation level.
